metadata.question: Was surface water present in the Alvord Desert basin, Oregon, on June 29, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Alvord Desert basin, Oregon (approximately 42.5°N, 118.5°W) - Date: June 29, 2025 - Collection: Use Sentinel-2 for water detection (10m resolution), with Landsat-8/9 as fallback - Water detection: Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or JRC Global Surface Water 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds since we need to detect actual surface water - Use QA bands for cloud masking - Water detection: NDWI > 0 typically indicates water 3. Logic: - Valid Zero (B): No water pixels found but we have valid data - C1: No images available for the date/location - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked (clouds/invalid) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Water pixels detected (NDWI > 0) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Alvord Desert basin geometry (approximate bounds) const alvordDesert = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-118.7, 42.7], [-118.3, 42.7], [-118.3, 42.3], [-118.7, 42.3], [-118.7, 42.7] ]); const targetDate = '2025-06-29'; const dateRange = 3; // days buffer // 2. Try Sentinel-2 first let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(alvordDesert) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); let collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); // Fallback to Landsat-9 if no Sentinel-2 if (collectionSize === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(alvordDesert) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(dateRange, 'day')); collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat-9 images found: ${collectionSize}`); } if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for the date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Process imagery function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const masked = collection.map(maskS2Clouds); const composite = masked.median(); // Calculate NDWI (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) const ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // 4. Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = await ndwi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: alvordDesert, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels after masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Detect water (NDWI > 0) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); const waterPixels = await waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: alvordDesert, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Water pixels detected: ${waterPixels}`); if (waterPixels === null || waterPixels === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (waterPixels > 0) { console.log('Surface water present.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No surface water detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
